Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood the task's primary focus by not clearly defining the "team" referenced in the question—whether it was the club team (ASC HLM in Senegal) or the national team (The Gambia). This ambiguity led to an incorrect assumption that both needed to be addressed equally, creating confusion and redundancy in subsequent steps. A more focused interpretation of the question would have clarified that the task was to identify the country of the club team Pa Amadou Gai is currently a member of, which is Senegal. This initial misdirection propagated throughout the conversation.
